gloss: daily allowance; daily pay; per diem

definitions.gloss: daily allowance; daily pay; per diem
definitions.explanation: A fixed amount of money paid per day, typically for work, jury duty, business travel expenses, or other daily compensation.

examples.japanese: {日当|にっとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一万|いちまん}→一万：27599_ichiman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧だ。
⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日当|にっとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A daily allowance is provided for business trips.

examples.japanese: {裁判員|さいばんいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日当|にっとう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{一万|いちまん}→一万：27599_ichiman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支払|しはら}われる→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: Lay judges are paid up to 10,000 yen per day as a daily allowance.

notes:
Refers to a fixed daily payment, distinct from regular salary or hourly wages. Common in contexts like business travel, temporary work, jury service, and volunteer compensation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日当|にっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay a daily allowance
- {日当|にっとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a per diem is provided
- {出張|しゅっちょう}{日当|にっとう}: business trip per diem
- {日当|にっとう}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: daily pay system

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日給|にっきゅう}→日給：07960_nikkyuu⟧: daily wage — specifically for work performed, while {日当|にっとう} can also cover travel expenses and non-work compensation
- ⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧: allowance — broader term covering various types of supplemental pay

USAGE:
Not to be confused with {日当|ひあ}たり (sun exposure, sunlight), which uses the same kanji but a different reading.
